title: Reminder for unacknowledged messages
summary: Injection shows a message; only acknowledgement settles it. The delivery hook re-presents an injected, unacknowledged message after the acknowledgement grace, then on a doubling backoff capped at one hour, on each surface's manifest inject events. The reminder carries a body excerpt, the full-body read command and the acknowledge command. A steering message handed to a new seat gets that seat's ordinary session receipt, so it injects and reminds the same way; acquire lists each ack command.
